_doc: Sentiment run registry (separate from configs/runs.json). A run (SR<NN>) is one fixed setup: data and training settings. Each model tried under it is a member SR<NN>-<model>. 'members' maps a result folder under results/sentiment/runs/ (with _seed<N> removed) to its run and model tag. src.sentiment.summarize_runs groups the score tables by this file.

runs.SR01: Real only (condition 1), S1 (ArSarcasm-v2), every roster classifier; BERTs 3 seeds, LLMs seed 42 first (SD-003)
